data.one_liner: A theming system and neutral widget library for Flutter that works alongside Material and Cupertino.
data.what_it_does: Orient UI provides a standalone Style class for colors, typography, radii, durations, and breakpoints, plus a collection of platform‑agnostic widgets such as buttons, navbars, popovers, and more. It lets you own the generated style file and customize it freely.
use_when: You need a lightweight theming solution without replacing MaterialApp
You want cross‑platform widgets that don’t depend on Material or Cupertino
You prefer to own and edit the generated style code
avoid_when: You require a tightly integrated Material design system
You need heavy UI kits with many pre‑styled components
strengths: Full control over generated style files
weaknesses: Limited component set compared to full UI kits
No built‑in state‑management or DI support

alternatives.name: flex_seed_scheme
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a theming system based on Material color seeds with no extra widgets
